The pair

Two apps, one job each.

Engine is the always-online half that talks. Vault is the always-offline half that signs. Neither can do the other's job — that's the point.

Vault

the safe · offline private-key anchor

Holds your private keys and signs your identity — on a device that physically cannot reach the network.

  • ✓No InternetNo INTERNET permission at all; keys sealed in Keystore TEE/DRM.
  • ✓Zero egressNothing leaves the device unless you approve a signature.
  • ✓Signs for EngineIdentity signatures cross devices over signed IPC callbacks.
More on Vault ↓ APK

Engine

the voice · end-to-end encrypted social

Your encrypted social client — chat, groups and identity, all E2E, all delegated to Vault for signing.

  • ✓E2E chatECDH + AES-256-GCM, AAD-bound anti-replay, open audit library.
  • ✓Pure memoryNo Room, no SQLite, no DataStore — kill it and it evaporates.
  • ✓Stateless relayThe relay only routes ciphertext; breach it and you get noise.
More on Engine ↓ APK

01

Create your offline safe. Your identity key is born here and never leaves this device.

02

03

Talk

End-to-end encrypted chat. Your identity signs across the room, not across the internet.
